features.notes: 73 keys E1–E7 (MIDI 28–100), 43 white / 30 black, real piano white/black pattern, 0.61 black-key height fraction.
Six ordered sections at spec fractions (14/20/8.5/12.5/25/20), 54/46 deck/keybed split, one continuous chassis, no marketing hero.
Stable control IDs, per-section landmarks and density, Program and Synth as the only primary OLEDs, OLEDs honestly labeled decorative.
Pointer press/release/cancel, keyboard-operated keys, window blur releases all held notes.
Every visible control moves or presses via pointer and keyboard; presentation state only — proven by asserting no voices and no status change.
Slider roles with names/values, button pressed states, labeled keys/keybed/OLEDs, live status region, visible focus styling.
Note on/off, repeated/overlapping notes, per-note release audible in signal, all-notes-off, voice counts return to baseline, bounded polyphony.
Pointer, independent multi-touch via pointerId, mapped computer keys with repeat suppression, MIDI note/velocity/CC64, denied and disconnected states, out-of-range MIDI ignored.
Velocity response and sustain duration proven on rendered signal (RMS/window energy); concurrent voices; deterministic oldest-released-then-oldest-held stealing.
Loading/ready transitions, honest labeled silent fallback on error, blur/disconnect/unmount stop every owned voice.

No hero, no detached rails, no missing keys, width pinned to 94vw with 3.0951 aspect ratio, narrow-viewport media query; pixel evidence in stage1-desktop.png / stage1-narrow.png and stage1-visual-audit.md.
